svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: A 7-node forest: A–B–C–D joined at 90/80/60, E–F at 70, G never joined. Descend into a cluster when its threshold ≤ cut; otherwise emit it whole.
Merges above the cut line are in effect; those below it have not happened yet at that threshold.

g.text: 7 nodes − 0 merges above the cut = 7 clusters
7 nodes − 1 merge above the cut = 6 clusters
7 nodes − 3 merges above the cut = 4 clusters

svg.text: The comparison is ≤, not <. At cut = 90 the A–B merge sits exactly on the line and is split back apart, because a cut keeps only
edges scoring strictly above it — a threshold’s own tie group is excluded, which is why the counts below match n_nodes − edges_above exactly.

text.tspan: Every node carries a slice of leaf_order, so a cluster’s members are leaf_order[leaf_start : leaf_start + leaf_count]:

svg.text: ← “ABC”, the cluster the cut at 65 emits, read straight out of the array
